clue.text: Lowest acceptable prices for books

definitions.meaning: at auction, the minimum bids a seller will accept
verb: books seats or tables, i.e. keeps them for someone

explanation.definitionFit: An auction's floor price is called its reserve, and to book a room is to reserve it.

clue.text: Sort of vehicle that can put a strain on a dramatist

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece placed on another sits above it

parts.note: to rick is to wrench or sprain a joint
George Bernard Shaw, Irish playwright

explanation.surface: A carriage that could overtax a playwright.
explanation.definitionFit: A light two-wheeled cart pulled by a runner is a kind of passenger transport.

clue.text: A loan isn't being negotiated for the plant

indicators.note: terms being negotiated are being reworked, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A loan is not under discussion for the factory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being negotiated' rearranges A LOAN ISNT; 'plant' looks like a factory.
explanation.definitionFit: Cotton lavender is an aromatic grey-leaved shrub of this genus.

clue.text: Deliver a tirade about the first person laughing

indicators.note: about says the tirade word goes round the pronoun

parts.note: to rant is to deliver a tirade
I is the first-person pronoun

explanation.surface: Ranting on about oneself, all the while laughing.
explanation.definitionFit: A literary adjective from French, meaning merry or cheerfully smiling.

clue.text: "O _____! model to thy inward greatness" (Hen V)

definitions.text: "O _____! model to thy inward greatness" (Hen V)

parts.words: "O _____! model to thy inward greatness" (Hen V)
parts.note: fill in the gap from the Chorus's speech in Shakespeare's Henry V, Act 2

explanation.definitionFit: The Chorus in Henry V apostrophises the nation whose king leads it to war in France.

clue.text: There are many great doctors in the world

parts.note: the Greek island of Cos (Kos), home of Hippocrates and his medical school, is the place with many great physicians
MOs are medical officers, army doctors

explanation.surface: A remark that the globe is full of eminent physicians.
explanation.walkthrough: COS is the Greek island where Hippocrates, the father of medicine, taught, so it is cryptically the place of 'many great' physicians.
explanation.definitionFit: The cosmos is the whole ordered universe, the world taken at its widest.

clue.text: Frank about relation's need for surgery

indicators.note: about says the frank word goes round the relation word

parts.note: open means frank or candid
a ratio is a quantitative relation between two amounts

explanation.surface: Candid talk about a relative needing an operation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'relation' looks like a relative; it is a mathematical ratio, which 'about' puts inside OPEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A surgical procedure is the standard word for a piece of surgery.

clue.text: Girls find a thousand is of some help

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
aids means helps

explanation.surface: Young women discover that a grand comes in handy.
explanation.definitionFit: Maidens, young unmarried women, is the old sense of the word.

clue.text: Mounted soldiers capture, an impressive' device

indicators.note: in a down clue mounted means raised up, so the soldiers word is read bottom to top

parts.note: GIs are American soldiers
to net is to capture

explanation.surface: Cavalry seize an imposing piece of equipment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mounted' suggests cavalry but turns GIS to SIG; 'impressive' means making impressions, as a seal does in wax.
explanation.definitionFit: A small seal, often on a ring, stamps a mark into wax.

clue.text: Greek with a German article he — puts in order

parts.note: der is the German masculine definite article

explanation.surface: A Greek and a German chap arrange things.
explanation.definitionFit: One who sorts or classifies items by quality or size ranks them.

clue.text: The Indian shot when caught by the governess

parts.note: C is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for caught
Anna Leonowens, the governess of The King and I (Anna and the King of Siam)

explanation.surface: A Native American is shot and then seized by a governess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The Indian shot' reads as a person being shot, but Indian shot is a plant name.
explanation.definitionFit: Indian shot is the common name of the tropical plant genus Canna, from its hard round seeds.

clue.text: Leisure activity of a down-to-earth stay-at-home

definitions.text: Leisure activity of a down-to-earth stay-at-home

parts.words: Leisure activity of a down-to-earth stay-at-home
parts.note: down-to-earth is taken literally: a hobby working the soil, done at home

explanation.definitionFit: Tending flower beds and vegetable plots is a hobby done in the soil around one's own house.

clue.text: Sign-writing

parts.note: not painting shop signs but writing in symbols, the stenographer's system of signs

explanation.definitionFit: Stenography records speech with abbreviated symbols rather than letters, literally writing in signs.

clue.text: The path trodden by those forming a union

definitions.text: The path trodden by those forming a union

parts.words: The path trodden by those forming a union
parts.note: the union is a marriage, and the path is the church walkway up to the altar

explanation.definitionFit: The bride and groom walk the central passage of a church between the pews at a wedding.

clue.text: A need' is, perhaps seen for distinctive taste

indicators.note: perhaps says these letters are only one possible arrangement, so they are to be reordered

explanation.surface: A want, maybe, is regarded as a sign of discernment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' makes ANISEED from the letters of A NEED IS.
explanation.definitionFit: The seed of the anise plant gives a strong liquorice-like flavour used in sweets and drinks.

clue.text: They'd remind people of their duty!

definitions.text: They'd remind people of their duty!

parts.words: They'd remind people of their duty!
parts.note: duty is not moral obligation but tax on goods, which certain officials collect

explanation.definitionFit: Customs officers of old collected taxes on goods, enforcing payments owed.

clue.text: Producing endless fruit

indicators.note: endless says the final letter of the synonym is cut off

parts.note: raising means producing, as in raising crops or a family

explanation.surface: A tree yielding fruit without stopping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' looks like it describes the fruit; it removes the G from RAISING.
explanation.definitionFit: A dried grape is a familiar fruit in cakes and puddings.

clue.text: Battered tins aren't. used immediately

indicators.note: battered tins are knocked out of shape, so the letters are bashed into a new order

explanation.surface: Dented cans are not used straight away.
explanation.definitionFit: An old legal adverb meaning at once, without delay.

clue.text: A hound lying around in a cradle

indicators.note: lying around says the dog word is stretched round the next piece

parts.note: a basset is a short-legged hound

explanation.surface: A dog sprawled about in a baby's cot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lying around' reads as the dog lazing about, but it is the container signal: the hound's name is stretched round the little word.
explanation.definitionFit: A hooded wicker basket on legs serves as a bed for a baby.

clue.text: A person expected to take, certain steps in time

definitions.text: A person expected to take, certain steps in time

parts.words: A person expected to take, certain steps in time
parts.note: sounds like someone bound to act promptly, but means one who moves the feet to music

explanation.definitionFit: A ballerina or tap performer moves the feet in set patterns keeping to the beat.

clue.text: Show contrition by creeping along the ground?

definitions.meaning: to feel sorry for one's sins
a botanical adjective, from Latin repere, crawl, for plants that trail

explanation.definitionFit: To be sorry is to rue one's sins, and the botanist's adjective describes trailing stems.

clue.text: Not remembering a name, is appalling

indicators.note: something appalling is dreadful, signalling these letters are badly mangled

explanation.surface: Forgetting someone's name is dreadful.
explanation.definitionFit: Memory loss is the state of failing to recall things.

clue.text: Pierced by a dress ornament

parts.note: broach is an older spelling of brooch, a pin worn on clothing

explanation.surface: Stabbed by a pin on a frock.
explanation.walkthrough: Abroach describes a cask that has been tapped open to let the liquor run.
explanation.definitionFit: A barrel set abroach has been tapped, its wood pierced to let the contents flow.

clue.text: A man of stone

definitions.meaning: an opaque red or brown quartz

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a boy's given name and a coloured variety of chalcedony quartz.

clue.text: A seagoing man turned back to get some maps

indicators.note: turned back means the sailor word is read in the reverse direction

parts.note: an old salt is an experienced sailor

explanation.surface: A sailor sets off home to fetch charts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned back' sounds like the sailor heading home; it reverses his word to give the last four letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A bound book of maps is called this, after the Titan shown holding up the heavens.

clue.text: Under the Left the alternative is : to be-a beast

indicators.note: in a down clue the later pieces sit below the earlier one

parts.note: L stands for left
or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: Under left-wing rule the only other choice is to behave like an animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A slow-moving nocturnal primate of South Asia is an animal.

clue.text: Quiet technicians, but they're champions

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet
artisans are skilled workers or craftsmen

explanation.surface: Silent mechanics who nonetheless back a cause.
explanation.definitionFit: Supporters who back a cause or person are its partisans, its zealous advocates.

clue.text: State one had written up nothing

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: in a down clue written up means set down from bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Someone once wrote up nothing at all.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the fifty US states, in the Pacific Northwest.

clue.text: Reason for a lighting offence

parts.note: not a street-lamp violation but the compulsion that makes someone set fires

explanation.definitionFit: An obsessive urge to start fires is the motive behind arson.

clue.text: Continue 'to work as a historian

definitions.meaning: to keep acting, carry on working, or proceed upon advice
Lord ..., Victorian historian famous for 'power tends to corrupt'

explanation.definitionFit: To act on is to keep functioning or carry out, and Lord Acton was the Cambridge historian.

clue.text: Having to phone around is revolting!

indicators.note: around says the phoning word encircles the other piece

parts.note: to ring someone is to phone them

explanation.surface: Calling all over the place is disgusting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolting' means disgusting on the surface but rebelling here; 'around' is the container signal for the phoning word.
explanation.definitionFit: A people in revolt are in a rising, an uprising against rulers.

clue.text: Modifications made 'to the car for a deified ruler

indicators.note: modifications made to some letters means they are altered into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Customising work done on a car belonging to a godlike king.
explanation.definitionFit: One who rules as a god or in a god's name holds power by divine authority.
